scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix Brand && npm install --prefix Professional/Frontend && npm install --prefix Professional/Backend && npm install --prefix School/Frontend && npm install --prefix School/Backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "SITE,PRO-WEB,PRO-API,SCH-WEB,SCH-API" -c "bgCyan,bgBlue,bgYellow,bgGreen,bgMagenta" "npm run dev --prefix Brand" "npm run dev --prefix Professional/Frontend" "npm run dev --prefix Professional/Backend" "npm run dev --prefix School/Frontend" "npm run dev --prefix School/Backend"
scripts.pro: concurrently -k -n "PRO-WEB,PRO-API" -c "bgBlue,bgYellow" "npm run dev --prefix Professional/Frontend" "npm run dev --prefix Professional/Backend"
scripts.school: concurrently -k -n "SCH-WEB,SCH-API" -c "bgGreen,bgMagenta" "npm run dev --prefix School/Frontend" "npm run dev --prefix School/Backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix Brand && npm run build --prefix Professional/Frontend && npm run build --prefix School/Frontend
